Cli.Help.Text:
MonitorSwitch CLI — switch profiles and adjust display parameters from the command line.

Usage: MonitorSwitch.exe <command> [args] [--json]

Profiles:
  list                                  List profiles ("*" marks the active one)
  apply <name|id>                       Switch to a profile
  save <name> [--replace]               Save the current setup as a profile
  delete <name|id>                      Delete a profile
  rename <old> <new>                    Rename a profile
  hotkey <name|id> <combo|none>         Set or clear its global hotkey (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+1)

Displays:
  displays                              List displays and their parameters
  set <display> <key> <value> [...]     Change parameters immediately
      keys: resolution 2560x1600 | refresh 144 | rotation 0|90|180|270
            hdr on|off | position 100,200
      display: number or name from "displays", or "all" (hdr/rotation only)
  topology <internal|clone|extend|external>   Projection shortcuts

Settings:
  config list                           Show app settings
  config set <key> <value>              theme | language | start-minimized |
                                        close-to-tray | revert-guard | autostart

Global:
  --json                                Machine-readable output (exit code 0 ok, 1 failed, 2 usage)
  help, version                         This text / app version

While MonitorSwitch is running, commands are relayed to the tray app and display
changes are protected by the 15-second revert guard. When it is not running, they
are applied directly, without the guard.
